companyContext: Lidl is a German international discount supermarket chain, part of the Schwarz Group. Founded in the 1930s, Lidl operates over 10,000 stores across 30+ countries in Europe and the United States, offering quality products at low prices. Lidl France participates in the French Days promotional event, offering exceptional discounts on their online store lidl.fr with tiered savings (e.g., 5€ off at 49€, 10€ off at 99€, 15€ off at 149€) and free shipping for Lidl Plus members.
brandContext: French Days is a major French e-commerce promotional event created in 2018 by six founding retailers (Boulanger, Cdiscount, Fnac Darty, La Redoute, Rue du Commerce, Showroomprivé). Lidl France participates actively in this event, offering exceptional discounts, coupon codes, and free delivery during the promotional period. The Spring 2026 edition runs from April 29 to May 5. The tagline is 'Les French Days, des offres engagées pour le pouvoir d'achat'. Lidl features products from its house brands (Silvercrest, Parkside, Esmara, Livergy, Livarno, Crivit, Rocktrail, Lupilu, Sanitas) at discounted prices.
productName: French Days 2026 – Remises exceptionnelles + Livraison offerte

typography.fontUses: Brand name, primary headings, hero banners, promotional headlines (e.g., 'FRENCH DAYS'), CTA buttons. Used for maximum impact and immediate brand recognition.
Subheadings, section titles, navigation labels, product category names, and secondary promotional callouts.
Body text, product descriptions, terms and conditions, informational content, and general paragraph copy across web and print.
Captions, fine print, metadata, timestamps, legal disclaimers, and small supplementary text.
Fallback font for web and email where the custom Lidl Font Pro is unavailable. Used for system-rendered text, accessible communications, and non-branded digital touchpoints.
Fallback bold for headings and emphasis in contexts where Lidl Font Pro cannot be loaded (email clients, third-party platforms).

brandVision: Lidl's French Days operation embodies the brand's commitment to making quality products accessible to all French consumers at unbeatable prices. The vision is to be the go-to discount retailer during France's biggest promotional events, combining Lidl's everyday low-price philosophy with exceptional limited-time offers. By participating in the French Days, Lidl reinforces its positioning as a modern, digital-savvy retailer that supports French purchasing power ('pouvoir d'achat') while maintaining product quality across house brands like Silvercrest, Parkside, and more.
brandValues: Accessibility and affordability for all customers. Quality products at discount prices without compromise. Supporting French consumers' purchasing power through meaningful promotions. Innovation through digital engagement via the Lidl Plus loyalty app. Reliability and trust built through transparent pricing. Community-driven commerce that aligns with French retail traditions. Sustainability and efficiency in operations. Customer-first approach with tiered discount structures, free shipping, and easy online shopping experiences.
